manifest.name: Kanban Board
manifest.author: CardSpoke Community
manifest.description: Adds a toggleable kanban view that groups cards into columns by tag with drag-friendly styling and column counts

css: .kanban-toggle { position: fixed; top: 10px; right: 10px; z-index: 10000; background: #8e44ad; color: white; border: none; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 20px; cursor: pointer; font-size: 13px; transition: all 0.2s ease; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(142,68,173,0.3); } .kanban-toggle:hover { background: #7d3c98; transform: scale(1.05); } .kanban-view { display: none; position: fixed; top: 50px; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; background: #f0f0f5; z-index: 9997; overflow-x: auto; padding: 20px; } .kanban-view.active { display: flex; gap: 16px; align-items: flex-start; } .kanban-column { min-width: 260px; max-width: 300px; background: #fff; border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.08); display: flex; flex-direction: column; max-height: calc(100vh - 100px); } .kanban-column-header { padding: 12px 16px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; border-bottom: 2px solid #eee; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; } .kanban-column-count { background: #e0e0e0; color: #666; font-size: 11px; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 10px; font-weight: normal; } .kanban-column-body { padding: 8px; overflow-y: auto; flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; } .kanban-card { padding: 10px 12px; background: #fafafa; border: 1px solid #eee; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 13px; cursor: default; transition: box-shadow 0.2s ease; } .kanban-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); } .kanban-card-title { font-weight: 500; margin-bottom: 4px; } .kanban-card-body { font-size: 11px; color: #888; max-height: 40px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .kanban-card-tags { margin-top: 6px; display: flex; gap: 4px; flex-wrap: wrap; } .kanban-card-tag { font-size: 10px; padding: 1px 6px; background: #e8e8f0; border-radius: 4px; color: #666; } body.dark-theme .kanban-view { background: #1a1a2a; } body.dark-theme .kanban-column { background: #22222e; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.3); } body.dark-theme .kanban-column-header { border-bottom-color: #333; color: #ddd; } body.dark-theme .kanban-column-count { background: #333; color: #aaa; } body.dark-theme .kanban-card { background: #2a2a3a; border-color: #333; } body.dark-theme .kanban-card-title { color: #ddd; } body.dark-theme .kanban-card-body { color: #888; } body.dark-theme .kanban-card-tag { background: #333; color: #aaa; }
